Vai Taivānā drīkst palikt līdz ARC uzdrukātajam datumam, ja darbs vai studijas, kuru dēļ atļauja saņemta, jau beigušies? [Imigrācijas likuma 31. pants](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=31) prasa Nacionālajai imigrācijas aģentūrai (NIA) atsaukt uzturēšanās atļauju un anulēt karti, kad zudis uzturēšanās pamats. Likums paredz arī konkrētus apstākļus, kuros NIA var atļaut uzturēties turpmāk.

Izmaiņas datums var prasīt pieteikumu vēl pirms kartes termiņa. Darba attiecību izbeigšanas paziņojums, studiju pabeigšanas apliecinājums vai ģimenes stāvokļa dokuments parāda notikumu un tā laiku. Saglabājiet šo ierakstu. [NIA norādījumi](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970) prasa pierādījumus, kas atbilst konkrētajam pagarinājumam vai izmaiņai.

## No kura notikuma skaita termiņu

| Situācija | Pieteikuma termiņš |
|---|---|
| Parasta ARC pagarināšana | Triju mēnešu laikā pirms uzturēšanās atļaujas beigām; pieteikums jāiesniedz, kamēr pašreizējā atļauja vēl spēkā. |
| Dzīvesvietas adreses vai darba vietas maiņa | Izmaiņu reģistrācija NIA jāpieprasa 30 dienu laikā no nākamās dienas pēc maiņas. |
| Uzturēšanās pamata maiņa Imigrācijas likuma 23-1. panta ietvaros | Pieteikums NIA 30 dienu laikā no notikuma dienas. |
| Uzturēšanās pamata maiņa ārpus 23-1. panta | Jaunas uzturēšanās vīzas pieteikums BOCA vai tā nodaļai 15 dienu laikā no notikuma, pēc tam uzturēšanās pieteikums NIA. |

Adreses un darba vietas reģistrācijas prasība ir [31. pantā](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=31); pamata maiņu un pagarināšanu regulē [uzturēšanās noteikumu 7. un 9. pants](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080129). Adreses maiņai skaitīšana sākas nākamajā dienā, bet uzturēšanās pamata maiņai — pašā notikuma dienā. BOCA norādītās 15 dienas ir pieteikuma iesniegšanai. Vīzas izsniegšana šajā laikā nav garantēta.

Dažām programmām pieteikšanās sākas agrāk. [Atbilstošs uzņēmējs, kurš turpina darbību Taivānā](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/348924/), ARC pagarinājumu var prasīt četru mēnešu laikā pirms termiņa beigām. Atsevišķajam turpmākas uzturēšanās ceļam pēc šīs darbības izbeigšanas ir triju mēnešu pieteikšanās periods pirms atļaujas beigām. [Gold Card atjaunošanu](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/406403/) var pieteikt četru mēnešu laikā pirms derīguma beigām.

## Ja darbs, studijas vai ģimenes pamats turpinās

Parastam pagarinājumam vajadzīga veidlapa, pase, esošā ARC, fotogrāfija un aktuāli uzturēšanās pamata pierādījumi. [NIA saraksts](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970) tos saista ar darbu, studijām vai ģimeni. Pēc pārcelšanās pievieno jaunās adreses apliecinājumu.

Dokumentiem jāaptver prasītais periods. Darba atļaujas beigu datums vai nākamā semestra reģistrācija var noteikt, cik ilgu pagarinājumu iespējams pamatot. Laikus saņemti dokumenti atstāj iespēju pirms ARC pieteikuma termiņa sagādāt trūkstošos reģistrācijas pierādījumus vai risināt jautājumu par darba atļauju, kuras derīgums drīz beigsies.

Ķīniešu valodas studijām ir šaurāks periods: [NIA studentu norādījumi](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/417829/cp_news) ļauj katru pagarinājumu piešķirt atbilstoši reģistrācijas pierādījumiem, bet ne ilgāk par sešiem mēnešiem. Īslaicīgās uzturēšanās un uzturēšanās ar atļauju kopējais ilgums parasti nepārsniedz divus gadus. Šo valodas apguves ierobežojumu nevar automātiski attiecināt uz visām grāda studijām.

Par katru apstiprināto gadu parastā pagarināšanas maksa ir NT$1,000, un arī periods, kas īsāks par gadu, maksā viena gada maksu saskaņā ar [maksu noteikumu 3. pantu](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080135). Apstiprināmo periodu nosaka uzturēšanās kategorija un pierādījumi. Samaksa pati par sevi nedod tiesības uz ilgāku atļauju.

Termiņš jau beidzies? Nekavējoties sazinieties ar NIA. [31. panta trešā daļa](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=31) paredz atkārtotu pieteikumu pēc soda piemērošanas, ja pārkavētais laiks ir mazāks par 30 dienām un sākotnējais uzturēšanās pamats turpinās. Vajadzīgi abi nosacījumi. Vecā atļauja ar to nepagarinās; turklāt pastāvīgās uzturēšanās vajadzībām aprēķinātajā uzturēšanās ilgumā šajā gadījumā jāatskaita viens gads.

## Pārcelšanās un darba devēja maiņa

Jauno adresi NIA piesaka ar tās pierādījumiem noteiktajā 30 dienu termiņā. Bankas, universitātes vai darba devēja informēšana neaizstāj imigrācijas reģistrācijas pieteikumu. Saglabājiet iesniegšanas datumu.

Darba devēja maiņai vai papildu darbam [Nodarbinātības pakalpojumu likuma 53. pants](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001) paredz atšķirīgas prasības atkarībā no darbinieka kategorijas. Pirms jaunā darba sākuma jābūt atļaujai vai atbrīvojumam, kas aptver konkrēto darbu. NIA ieraksta maiņa pati par sevi šo darbu neatļauj.

Pārejai pie cita darba devēja noteiktajā procedūrā prasa iepriekšējā darba izbeigšanas pierādījumu. Šo prasību nevar pārvērst par vispārēju pienākumu pamest pirmo darbu ikvienā papildu nodarbinātības gadījumā. Jāvērtē attiecīgā darba kategorija un atļauja.

## Kad iepriekšējais uzturēšanās pamats zudis

Pēc absolvēšanas, darba attiecību beigām vai ģimenes stāvokļa maiņas jaunu pamatu var pieprasīt [Imigrācijas likuma 23-1. pantā](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=23-1) uzskaitītajās situācijās. Katru pamata maiņu šis pants neaptver.

Turpmāku uzturēšanos NIA var atļaut arī [31. panta](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=31) apstākļos: piemēram, miris ģimenes loceklis, uz kura statusu balstījās atļauja, vai pastāv likumā noteiktais ar bērnu saistītais pamats. Bērna gadījumā nozīme ir nepilngadībai, Taivānas mājsaimniecības reģistrācijai un attiecīgajiem aprūpes, tiesību un pienākumu vai saskarsmes nosacījumiem. Darba strīda pamats attiecas uz notiekošu tiesvedību ar Taivānas darba devēju, bet darba traumas pamats — uz turpinātu ārstēšanos.

Vardarbības ģimenē dēļ šķirtas laulības izņēmumā ārvalstu pieteicējs ir tas, kurš nedrīkst būt atkārtoti apprecējies. Bijušajam laulātajam jābūt Taivānā dzīvojošam Taivānas pilsonim ar mājsaimniecības reģistrāciju, un laulībai jābūt šķirtai vardarbības dēļ. Ar šķiršanos vai darba strīdu vien nepietiek, lai automātiski iegūtu turpmākas uzturēšanās tiesības.

Atbilstošs profesionālis var pirms atļaujas beigām pieteikties [speciālistu likuma 17. panta](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) pagarinājumam. Ja pieteikumu apstiprina, piešķir sešus mēnešus no nākamās dienas pēc sākotnējās ARC vai Gold Card derīguma beigām. Iespējams vēl viens pagarinājums, kopā nepārsniedzot gadu. Tas nepagarina iepriekšējo darba atļauju automātiski.

Absolventiem [uzturēšanās noteikumu 11. pants](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080129) paredz citu ceļu. Ja NIA apstiprina atbilstoša absolventa pirms termiņa beigām iesniegtu pieteikumu, piešķir vienu gadu no nākamās dienas pēc iepriekšējā termiņa beigām. Pirms pagarinājuma beigām var lūgt vēl vienu, kopā līdz diviem gadiem. Vienkārša valodas kursa pabeigšana nav šā ceļa akadēmiskā kvalifikācija.

Taivānā associate degree vai augstāku grādu nesen ieguvušam absolventam, kuram NIA apstiprinājusi uzturēšanās pagarinājumu absolventa statusā, [speciālistu likuma 12. pants](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) šā pagarinājuma laikā paredz atbrīvojumu no darba atļaujas. Tas neattiecas uz jebkuru studentu vai jebkuru darba meklēšanai izmantotu ARC.

Sākotnējā e-pastā par uzturēšanos ietekmējošu darba vai ģimenes strīdu uz [wei@hoveringlaw.com.tw](mailto:wei@hoveringlaw.com.tw) var īsi norādīt notikumu un būtiskos datumus. Pases numuru un identitātes dokumentu oriģinālus šai pirmajai ziņai nepievienojiet. Konsultācijas notiek angļu, ķīniešu, japāņu vai korejiešu valodā.

## Jauna pase vai nozaudēta karte

Pases atjaunošanai jāseko atbilstošai NIA datu atjaunošanai, kā skaidro [NIA jautājumi un atbildes](https://news.immigration.gov.tw/EasyPack/Detail/DDA469F4-E2D0-4A98-847C-21432DCC040E?lang=EN). Izmaiņu pieteikumam [dokumentu saraksts](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970) prasa veidlapu, fotogrāfiju, pasi un izmaiņas pierādījumu. Vecā pase vai kopija palīdz sasaistīt abus ierakstus. Visām pases izmaiņām nevar pieņemt vienu kopēju 30 dienu termiņu.

ARC nozaudēšanas vai bojājuma gadījumā iesniedz bojāto karti, paziņojumu par nozaudēšanu, policijas izziņu vai citus situācijai atbilstošus pierādījumus. Policijas izziņa nav vienīgais variants. [Maksu noteikumu 7. pantā](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080135) parastā atkārtotas izsniegšanas maksa ir NT$500. Jauna karte uzturēšanās periodu nepagarina.

Nozaudēšana ārvalstīs ietekmē arī atgriešanos. Pirms brauciena sazinieties ar NIA un [attiecīgo Taivānas pārstāvniecību](https://www.boca.gov.tw/sp-foof-countrylp-01-2.html), norādot pases datus, ARC kopiju, ja tāda ir, un plānoto atgriešanās dienu. Tās var precizēt vajadzīgo dokumentu. Iespēja pieteikt kartes aizstāšanu ārvalstīs pati par sevi negarantē iekāpšanu lidmašīnā vai ieceļošanu.

## Izbraukšana, kamēr pieteikumu vēl izskata

Parastā atkārtotas ieceļošanas atļauja saskaņā ar [Imigrācijas likuma 34. pantu](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=34) vajadzīga pirms izbraukšanas. [Uzturēšanās noteikumu 20. pants](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080129) sasaista tās derīgumu ar ARC periodu un anulē atļauju, ja anulēta ARC. Pastāvīgās uzturēšanās atļaujas saņēmējam ir izņēmums: ar derīgu pasi un APRC var atgriezties bez atsevišķas atkārtotas ieceļošanas atļaujas.

Kamēr pagarināšana vai kartes aizstāšana vēl procesā, pirms izbraukšanas saņemiet NIA norādījumus konkrētajam braucienam. Iesniegšanas kvīts automātiski neaizstāj vajadzīgos ceļošanas dokumentus. Pases un atļauju derīgums jāpārbauda plānotajai atgriešanās dienai.

NIA [konkrētajā profesionāļu un ģimenes locekļu tiešsaistes procedūrā](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5382/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/httpscoaimmigrationgovtwcoa-frontendforeign-white-collar/) pieteikuma izskatīšanu neturpina, ja pieteicējs tās laikā izbrauc no Taivānas. Pēc atkārtotas ieceļošanas var iesniegt jaunu pieteikumu, ja atkal izpildīti attiecīgās kategorijas nosacījumi. Tas ir šīs tiešsaistes kārtības noteikums, nevis vispārējs izceļošanas aizliegums ARC pieteicējiem vai garantija atgriezties.

Pirmo dokumentu sagatavošanu skaidro [pirmās ARC pieteikums](/lv/columns/taiwan-arc-first-application), bet jaunu pamatu — [darba, studiju un ģimenes ceļi](/lv/columns/taiwan-visa-residence-work-study-family). Par pastāvīgo uzturēšanos pieejams [APRC raksts angļu valodā](/en/columns/taiwan-permanent-residence-aprc). Pirms izbraukšanas jāzina, kuri derīgie dokumenti būs līdzi plānotajā atgriešanās dienā.

Juridiskie avoti pārbaudīti 2026. gada 24. oktobrī; atsevišķi nosacījumi un tiešsaistes izbraukšanas sekas papildus salīdzinātas 25. oktobrī. Šeit aprakstītas ārvalstnieku procedūras un nosacīti izņēmumi, nevis izlemta konkrēta lieta. Kontinentālās Ķīnas, Honkongas un Makao iedzīvotājiem, kā arī Ķīnas Republikas pilsoņiem bez mājsaimniecības reģistrācijas ir atsevišķa kārtība.

- [Ārvalstu speciālistu piesaistes un nodarbināšanas likums](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295), 12. un 17. pants; [Nodarbinātības pakalpojumu likums](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001), 53. pants.

sourceEvidence.text: NIA registration is due within 30 days counted from the day after the change. A new employer may also require work authorization, and a change in the basis for residence may require a separate application. Updating the address or workplace record does not complete those procedures.

Can you stay until the expiry date printed on your Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) if the job, course or family relationship supporting it ends sooner? Immigration Act Article 31 requires the National Immigration Agency (NIA) to revoke residence permission and cancel the card when the reason for residence disappears, subject to the statutory grounds on which NIA may approve continued residence.
Within 30 days counted from the day after the change.
Change of residence reason qualifying under Immigration Act Article 23-1
Application to NIA within 30 days from the event date.
Change of residence reason outside Article 23-1
The residence regulations prescribe a new resident-visa application to BOCA within 15 days from the event, followed by the NIA residence application.

Immigration Act Article 31 governs address and workplace registration; Articles 7 and 9 of the residence regulations govern changes of residence reason and extensions. Address changes are counted from the following day, while the regulations count a change of residence reason from the event date.

Standard extension fees are NT$1,000 per year of approved validity; a shorter period is charged as one year under Article 3 of the immigration permit fee standards. The residence category determines the period NIA may approve. Paying for a longer period does not create an entitlement to it.

Already past expiry? Contact NIA immediately. Article 31 allows a limited reapplication after a penalty when the overstay is less than 30 days and the original residence reason continues. That provision leaves the original expiry date unchanged; it is not an ordinary grace period.

A move requires new address evidence and NIA registration within the 30-day period. Updating a bank, university or employer's records does not complete the immigration registration required by Article 31. Keep the dated submission record.

For a new employer or an additional job, Employment Service Act Article 53 sets requirements that differ by worker category. The new work must be covered by the applicable permit or exemption before it begins. An NIA address or workplace update does not itself authorize that employment.

After graduation, termination of employment or a family-status change, an ARC holder may apply for a new residence basis under Immigration Act Article 23-1 only in the situations that provision lists.

Continued residence may also be available under Article 31, including specified circumstances involving a deceased family sponsor, domestic violence, children in Taiwan, labor litigation or an occupational injury. Each ground has its own conditions, so a divorce or employment dispute alone does not establish either a right to remain or an inevitable obligation to leave.

Qualifying professionals can seek the extension in Foreign Professionals Act Article 17. If approved, it runs for six months from the day after the original ARC or Gold Card expires. One further extension is available, up to a total of one year. Apply before expiry. Graduates have a different extension framework under Article 11 of the residence regulations, with eligibility tied to the completed program; the professional timetable does not apply to every student.

NIA's guide lists the damaged card, a loss declaration, a police report or other evidence as appropriate when an ARC is lost or damaged. Article 7 of the fee standards sets the standard replacement fee at NT$500. Replacing the card does not extend residence.

Re-entry requires valid permission under Immigration Act Article 34. Article 20 of the residence regulations ties that permission to the ARC's validity period and cancels it when the ARC is canceled. The permission recorded with the card therefore needs to cover the intended return date, along with the passport and residence status.

Legal sources checked October 24, 2026. This guide describes foreign-national procedures and category-specific exceptions, without determining an individual case. Mainland China residents, Hong Kong and Macau residents, and ROC nationals without household registration follow separate frameworks.

Pieteikums NIA 30 dienu laikā no notikuma dienas.
Uzturēšanās pamata maiņa ārpus 23-1. panta
Jaunas uzturēšanās vīzas pieteikums BOCA vai tā nodaļai 15 dienu laikā no notikuma, pēc tam uzturēšanās pieteikums NIA.

Adreses un darba vietas reģistrācijas prasība ir 31. pantā; pamata maiņu un pagarināšanu regulē uzturēšanās noteikumu 7. un 9. pants. Adreses maiņai skaitīšana sākas nākamajā dienā, bet uzturēšanās pamata maiņai — pašā notikuma dienā. BOCA norādītās 15 dienas ir pieteikuma iesniegšanai. Vīzas izsniegšana šajā laikā nav garantēta.

Par katru apstiprināto gadu parastā pagarināšanas maksa ir NT$1,000, un arī periods, kas īsāks par gadu, maksā viena gada maksu saskaņā ar maksu noteikumu 3. pantu. Apstiprināmo periodu nosaka uzturēšanās kategorija un pierādījumi. Samaksa pati par sevi nedod tiesības uz ilgāku atļauju.

Termiņš jau beidzies? Nekavējoties sazinieties ar NIA. 31. panta trešā daļa paredz atkārtotu pieteikumu pēc soda piemērošanas, ja pārkavētais laiks ir mazāks par 30 dienām un sākotnējais uzturēšanās pamats turpinās. Vajadzīgi abi nosacījumi. Vecā atļauja ar to nepagarinās; turklāt pastāvīgās uzturēšanās vajadzībām aprēķinātajā uzturēšanās ilgumā šajā gadījumā jāatskaita viens gads.

Jauno adresi NIA piesaka ar tās pierādījumiem noteiktajā 30 dienu termiņā. Bankas, universitātes vai darba devēja informēšana neaizstāj imigrācijas reģistrācijas pieteikumu. Saglabājiet iesniegšanas datumu.

Darba devēja maiņai vai papildu darbam Nodarbinātības pakalpojumu likuma 53. pants paredz atšķirīgas prasības atkarībā no darbinieka kategorijas. Pirms jaunā darba sākuma jābūt atļaujai vai atbrīvojumam, kas aptver konkrēto darbu. NIA ieraksta maiņa pati par sevi šo darbu neatļauj.

Turpmāku uzturēšanos NIA var atļaut arī 31. panta apstākļos: piemēram, miris ģimenes loceklis, uz kura statusu balstījās atļauja, vai pastāv likumā noteiktais ar bērnu saistītais pamats. Bērna gadījumā nozīme ir nepilngadībai, Taivānas mājsaimniecības reģistrācijai un attiecīgajiem aprūpes, tiesību un pienākumu vai saskarsmes nosacījumiem. Darba strīda pamats attiecas uz notiekošu tiesvedību ar Taivānas darba devēju, bet darba traumas pamats — uz turpinātu ārstēšanos.

Atbilstošs profesionālis var pirms atļaujas beigām pieteikties speciālistu likuma 17. panta pagarinājumam. Ja pieteikumu apstiprina, piešķir sešus mēnešus no nākamās dienas pēc sākotnējās ARC vai Gold Card derīguma beigām. Iespējams vēl viens pagarinājums, kopā nepārsniedzot gadu. Tas nepagarina iepriekšējo darba atļauju automātiski.

Absolventiem uzturēšanās noteikumu 11. pants paredz citu ceļu. Ja NIA apstiprina atbilstoša absolventa pirms termiņa beigām iesniegtu pieteikumu, piešķir vienu gadu no nākamās dienas pēc iepriekšējā termiņa beigām. Pirms pagarinājuma beigām var lūgt vēl vienu, kopā līdz diviem gadiem. Vienkārša valodas kursa pabeigšana nav šā ceļa akadēmiskā kvalifikācija.

Taivānā associate degree vai augstāku grādu nesen ieguvušam absolventam, kuram NIA apstiprinājusi uzturēšanās pagarinājumu absolventa statusā, speciālistu likuma 12. pants šā pagarinājuma laikā paredz atbrīvojumu no darba atļaujas. Tas neattiecas uz jebkuru studentu vai jebkuru darba meklēšanai izmantotu ARC.

Pases atjaunošanai jāseko atbilstošai NIA datu atjaunošanai, kā skaidro NIA jautājumi un atbildes. Izmaiņu pieteikumam dokumentu saraksts prasa veidlapu, fotogrāfiju, pasi un izmaiņas pierādījumu. Vecā pase vai kopija palīdz sasaistīt abus ierakstus. Visām pases izmaiņām nevar pieņemt vienu kopēju 30 dienu termiņu.

ARC nozaudēšanas vai bojājuma gadījumā iesniedz bojāto karti, paziņojumu par nozaudēšanu, policijas izziņu vai citus situācijai atbilstošus pierādījumus. Policijas izziņa nav vienīgais variants. Maksu noteikumu 7. pantā parastā atkārtotas izsniegšanas maksa ir NT$500. Jauna karte uzturēšanās periodu nepagarina.

Parastā atkārtotas ieceļošanas atļauja saskaņā ar Imigrācijas likuma 34. pantu vajadzīga pirms izbraukšanas. sourceHints.text: Can you stay until the expiry date printed on your Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) if the job, course or family relationship supporting it ends sooner? Immigration Act Article 31 requires the National Immigration Agency (NIA) to revoke residence permission and cancel the card when the reason for residence disappears, subject to the statutory grounds on which NIA may approve continued residence.

Some programs allow an earlier renewal application. A qualifying entrepreneur ARC extension for a continuing Taiwan business can be filed during the four months before expiry. The separate continued-residence route after that business ceases has a three-month advance window. Gold Card renewal opens four months before expiry.

An ordinary extension requires the form, passport, existing ARC, photograph and current evidence of the reason for residence. NIA's guide calls for employment, study or family documents as appropriate, plus new address evidence if you have moved.

Continued residence may also be available under Article 31, including specified circumstances involving a deceased family sponsor, domestic violence, children in Taiwan, labor litigation or an occupational injury. Each ground has its own conditions, so a divorce or employment dispute alone does not establish either a right to remain or an inevitable obligation to leave.

An initial email to Hovering International Law Firm at wei@hoveringlaw.com.tw about an employment or family dispute affecting residence should state the event and relevant dates. Leave passport numbers and original identity documents out of that message.

A renewed passport requires a corresponding update to NIA's records, as its passport-renewal FAQ explains. For a data change, NIA's checklist requires the application, photograph, passport and evidence of the change. Keeping the old passport or a copy helps connect the old and new records.

Loss abroad also affects the return journey. Before attempting to travel back, contact NIA and the relevant Taiwan overseas mission with your passport details, an ARC copy if available, and intended return date. They can identify which document your circumstances require.

Re-entry requires valid permission under Immigration Act Article 34. Article 20 of the residence regulations ties that permission to the ARC's validity period and cancels it when the ARC is canceled. The permission recorded with the card therefore needs to cover the intended return date, along with the passport and residence status.

Legal sources checked October 24, 2026. This guide describes foreign-national procedures and category-specific exceptions, without determining an individual case. Mainland China residents, Hong Kong and Macau residents, and ROC nationals without household registration follow separate frameworks.
NIA, new immigrant FAQs, questions 2 and 3: card loss and passport updates.
Taiwan overseas mission directory: offices for overseas inquiries.
Passport updates and replacement cards

The general extension window opens three months before authorized residence expires. Gold Card renewal and qualifying entrepreneur ARC extensions for a continuing Taiwan business have separate four-month windows. These are advance filing periods, not grace periods after expiry.
Can I return to Taiwan with an ARC renewal receipt?

A receipt should not be assumed to replace the required travel documents. Before departure, ask NIA what document covers your return if the renewed card is still pending. Your passport, residence status and re-entry permission must cover the journey.

targetFields.text: Prvi ARC na Tajvanu: od katerega dne teče rok?
Prvi tajvanski ARC: rok, listine in prevzem
Rok za prvo izkaznico ARC je odvisen od vstopa in izdaje vizuma. Preverite dokazila za prebivanje, pristojni postopek, pristojbine in poziv k dopolnitvi.
Nevtralna potna knjižica, mapa z dokumenti in majhna prazna kartica na mizi za pripravo vloge.
Izmišljen prizor
Ali rok za prvi ARC vedno teče od prihoda na Tajvan?

Pri vstopu z vizumom za prebivanje in dovoljenim prebivanjem je treba zaprositi v 30 dneh od dne po prihodu. Če vizum za prebivanje dobite šele na Tajvanu, BOCA šteje 30 dni od njegove izdaje. Neposredna prijava obiskovalca pri NIA zahteva izpolnitev pogojev njegove kategorije; veljaven združen dokument s funkcijo ARC pa omogoča izjemo od ločene prijave.
Koliko znaša običajna pristojbina za ARC?

Za vsako leto odobrene veljavnosti znaša NT$1.000; obdobje, krajše od leta, se obračuna kot leto. Za zadevne prijave po brezvizumskem vstopu ali vstopu z vizumom za obisk se prišteje NT$2.200. Posebne oprostitve in znižanja veljajo le za določene upravičence.
Ali prejem ARC zadošča za začetek dela?
Za konkretno delo in delodajalca mora veljati ustrezno delovno dovoljenje ali zakonska izjema. ARC dokazuje dovoljeno prebivanje, sam pa ne daje neomejene pravice do dela.

sourcePassages.text: Thirty days is the filing period for your first Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) if you enter Taiwan on a resident visa and receive residence permission. Count from the day after arrival. Immigration Act Article 22 requires the application to the National Immigration Agency (NIA), which issues the card as evidence of approved residence.

Visitors have a different starting point: they must qualify for a permitted change to residence before they can apply. Holding a valid combined document with ARC functions, such as an Employment Gold Card, removes the need for a separate card under the exception in Article 22.
Your visa and entry record determine the deadline. Someone who receives a resident visa while already in Taiwan uses a different starting date from someone who arrives with one.
Entry and visa status
When to apply
Entered with a resident visa
Within 30 days counted from the day after entry.
Received a resident visa after arriving in Taiwan
Within 30 days from the resident visa's issuance date, under BOCA's guidance.
Entered visa-exempt or with a visitor visa
Before the permitted stay expires, subject to the eligibility and filing rules for the residence category.

NIA's residence guide and BOCA's resident-visa guidance explain the first two situations. For eligible professionals, Article 16 of the Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals permits a direct NIA residence application after visitor-visa or visa-exempt entry, with work authorization or an applicable exemption. Eligibility is specific to that route; the work, study and family comparison explains the conditions for other applicants.

An application based on a resident visa needs the form, photograph, passport and resident visa, evidence of the reason for residence, and proof of your current address, according to NIA's checklist. Bring the required originals and copies. A lease is one accepted address document.
The supporting evidence depends on why you are staying:
Employment: the relevant work approval and a certificate of employment issued within the preceding month, or evidence of the applicable exemption.
Degree study: an admission letter before registration, or recent enrollment evidence once registered.
Family residence: marriage or birth records proving the relationship, together with the sponsoring family member's identity or residence documents.

For a first application through marriage to a Taiwan national with household registration, the Taiwan spouse must attend. NIA also requires proof that the marriage is registered in Taiwan and gives the first spouse-based card one-year validity. These requirements appear in the NIA guide; the Taiwan-spouse residence article covers the family documents in more detail.

Certificates issued abroad may take longer to prepare than the application form. NIA requires authentication of overseas documents and may ask for a Chinese translation verified or notarized in the prescribed manner. The Taiwan overseas mission responsible for the place of issue can explain the authentication procedure. Police certificates and health examinations depend on the particular visa or residence category; they are not required in every first-card application.

NIA's residence application directory separates general residence applications from those for professionals and their dependents, students, and migrant workers. Each category has a designated online system or service-center procedure. Using the professional-worker system is appropriate only if your employment category belongs there.

Students use a dedicated online procedure. For the ordinary in-person application, the relevant NIA service center is the one covering your current address; NIA specifically directs Taiwan-spouse applications there in its residence guide.
Keep the submission record and uploaded documents. If NIA requests further evidence, retaining the request with the original file makes it clear which documents still need to be supplied.

Standard ARC fees are NT$1,000 for each year of approved validity, with a period under one year charged as a full year. Article 3 of the immigration permit fee standards adds NT$2,200 for applications following visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. Its reduction for overseas compatriot students applies to that status, not to international students generally.

NIA decides the approved term. The ordinary statutory maximum is three years, while qualifying specialist professionals have a separate maximum under their legislation (Immigration Act Article 22; Foreign Professionals Act Article 8). Paying a higher fee cannot establish eligibility for a longer period.

For general applications, NIA gives a processing time of ten working days, excluding document return, requests for additional documents and interviews. The processing period starts again after the additional documents are submitted. Online categories have their own schedules, which may affect travel plans while the application is pending.

Under the student online procedure, payment is due within five working days from approval. A student collecting a smart-chip ARC must print the online payment receipt and take it to the selected NIA service center three working days after payment. That timetable applies to this student procedure; other applicants should follow the method and identification requirements in their approval or collection notice.

Check the issued card against your application. The name, passport details, address and residence expiry date should match the approved particulars; keep the receipt and decision with your immigration records.

An ARC alone does not authorize every job. Before starting work, the relevant permit or exemption must cover the actual employment under Employment Service Act Articles 43 and 48. Once you have the card, its expiry date and any later changes to your address or employment determine the next filings; travel may also require attention to re-entry permission. Those situations are covered in the renewal and changes guide.

When does the deadline for my first ARC start?

For entry with a resident visa and residence permission, the 30-day period starts the day after arrival. If the resident visa is issued after you arrive, BOCA's guidance counts 30 days from its issuance. Visitors applying directly for residence must meet the eligibility and filing rules for their category.
How much does a first ARC cost?

The standard charge is NT$1,000 for each year of approved validity; a period under one year is charged as one year. Applications after visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry carry an additional NT$2,200 under the fee rules. Specified reductions and exemptions may apply.
Can I start work once I receive an ARC?
Only if the actual job and employer are covered by the permit or exemption that applies to you. An ARC records residence permission; it does not by itself establish unrestricted work rights.

Only if the actual job and employer are covered by the permit or exemption that applies to you. An ARC records residence permission; it does not by itself establish unrestricted work rights.

Izkaznica ARC nato izkazuje odobreno prebivanje.

Najprej odprite potni list in zapis o vstopu. Pri vizumu, izdanem šele po prihodu, se rok začne drugače; obiskovalec pa mora najprej izpolnjevati pogoje za ustrezno pot do prebivanja. Veljaven združen dokument, ki že vsebuje funkcijo ARC, denimo Employment Gold Card, po istem členu odpravlja potrebo po ločeni prijavi za izkaznico.

Brezvizumski vstop ali vizum za obisk
Pred iztekom dovoljenega kratkotrajnega bivanja, po pogojih in pravilih za prijavo v konkretni kategoriji.

Za določene tuje strokovnjake obstaja neposredna prijava pri NIA. 16. člen zakona o pridobivanju in zaposlovanju tujih strokovnjakov jo omogoča tujim strokovnjakom oziroma strokovnjakom s posebnimi znanji, ki vstopijo brez vizuma ali z vizumom za obisk in imajo dovoljenje za strokovno delo ali ustrezno izjemo. Ponudba za zaposlitev sama ne nadomesti te podlage. ARC dobijo po odobritvi.

Katera pot velja za študij ali družino? Pogoji so zbrani v primerjavi dela, študija in družinskega prebivanja. Tridesetdnevni rok za prvega imetnika vizuma za prebivanje ni splošno obdobje, v katerem lahko vsak obiskovalec spremeni status.

Pri prijavi na podlagi vizuma za prebivanje seznam NIA zahteva obrazec, fotografijo iz zadnjih dveh let, potni list in vizum, dokazila o razlogu prebivanja ter sedanjem naslovu. Pripravite zahtevane izvirnike in kopije. Naslov je mogoče dokazovati denimo z najemno pogodbo.
Del dokumentacije je vezan na razlog prijave:
Pri zaposlitvi sta pomembna ustrezna odobritev dela in potrdilo o zaposlitvi, izdano v zadnjem mesecu, oziroma dokazilo o veljavni izjemi.

Pred vpisom na študij se predloži dokazilo o sprejemu. Po vpisu se uporabljajo ustrezna nedavna dokazila o vpisu; navodila dopuščajo potrdilo o vpisu za tekoči semester iz zadnjega meseca ali študentsko izkaznico, ob zahtevanem preverjanju registracije.
Družinska prijava zahteva dokazila o zakonski zvezi ali rojstvu in listine o identiteti oziroma prebivanju družinskega člana, na katerega se prijava opira.

Pri prvi prijavi na podlagi zakonske zveze s tajvanskim državljanom, ki prebiva na Tajvanu in ima tam gospodinjsko registracijo, je zakonska najdaljša veljavnost prvega ARC eno leto. NIA zahteva tudi navzočnost tajvanskega zakonca in dokazilo o registraciji zakonske zveze na Tajvanu. Enako navzočnost določa pri spremembi razloga prebivanja zaradi poroke. Podrobnejša razlaga družinskih listin je v angleščini.

Overitev lahko traja dlje kot izpolnjevanje obrazca. Listine iz tujine morajo biti overjene po predpisanem postopku, NIA pa lahko zahteva še kitajski prevod, ki ga potrdi pristojno predstavništvo ali overi tajvanski notar. Postopek preverite pri tajvanskem predstavništvu, pristojnem za kraj izdaje. Potrdilo o nekaznovanosti in zdravstveni pregled sta odvisna od prijavne poti in njenih izjem; nista obvezna pri vsaki prvi izkaznici.

Imenik postopkov NIA ločuje običajne prijave, postopke za strokovnjake in njihove družine, študente ter druge kategorije delavcev. Izbrani spletni sistem mora ustrezati vaši kategoriji. Pri običajni osebni prijavi je pristojen center NIA za sedanji naslov; tja agencija izrecno usmerja tudi prijave zakoncev tajvanskih državljanov.
Študenti imajo poseben spletni postopek. Shranite oddano vlogo in vse priloge. Tako bo ob pozivu razvidno, katero dokazilo manjka in katera različica je že v spisu.

Za dopolnitev običajne vloge kitajska navodila NIA 0902 določajo 15 dni od dne po obvestilu. Gre za koledarske dni. Če je treba manjkajoče ali neustrezne listine pridobiti v tujini, celinski Kitajski, Hongkongu ali Macau, je rok za dopolnitev tri mesece; ne prišteva se k prvotnim 15 dnem. NIA prijavo zavrne, če zahtevane dopolnitve niso predložene pravočasno ali ostanejo nepopolne.

Običajna pristojbina je NT$1.000 za vsako leto odobrene veljavnosti, krajše obdobje pa se obračuna kot eno leto. 3. člen pravil o pristojbinah za zadevne prijave po brezvizumskem vstopu ali vizumu za obisk dodaja NT$2.200. Polovično znižanje za kategorijo študentov iz čezmorske kitajske skupnosti, 僑生, ne velja za vse mednarodne študente.

Trajanje določi dovoljena podlaga prebivanja. Običajna zakonska zgornja meja je tri leta, za zaposlene strokovnjake s posebnimi znanji in določene družinske člane pa velja posebna ureditev do petih let (22. člen zakona o priseljevanju; 8. člen zakona o tujih strokovnjakih). Gold Card ima svojo veljavnost od enega do treh let. Višje plačilo samo ne zagotovi daljšega prebivanja.

NIA za običajno vlogo navaja deset delovnih dni, brez časa za vračanje listin, dopolnitve in razgovore. Po dopolnitvi se čas obravnave šteje znova. Pri študentskem spletnem postopku je navedeni čas pet delovnih dni in se po dopolnitvi prav tako začne znova. To ni zagotovljen datum izdaje ali samodejno podaljšanje dovoljenega bivanja.

Kdaj študent plača in dobi kartico? Po študentskih spletnih navodilih mora plačati v petih delovnih dneh od odobritve. Elektronski ARC z veljavnostjo največ šest mesecev mora po plačilu prenesti in natisniti. Za kartico s čipom mora natisniti spletno potrdilo o plačilu in jo prevzeti v izbranem centru NIA tri delovne dni po plačilu. Drugi prosilci upoštevajo način prevzema, naveden v svoji odločbi oziroma obvestilu.

Ob prevzemu primerjajte ime, potni list, naslov in datum izteka z odobrenimi podatki. Odločbo in potrdilo shranite skupaj. Za začetek dela mora ustrezno dovoljenje ali izjema pokrivati konkretno zaposlitev po 43. in 48. členu zakona o zaposlitvenih storitvah; ARC sam ne dovoljuje vsakega dela. Poznejše spremembe naslova, zaposlitve ali potovalnih načrtov obravnava vodnik po podaljšanju in ponovnem vstopu.

Podlaga so uradni viri, preverjeni 24. in 25. oktobra 2026. Besedilo obravnava sistem za tuje državljane. Prebivalci celinske Kitajske, Hongkonga in Macaa ter tajvanski državljani brez gospodinjske registracije imajo ločene pravne okvire.

Ali rok za prvi ARC vedno teče od prihoda na Tajvan?

Pri vstopu z vizumom za prebivanje in dovoljenim prebivanjem je treba zaprositi v 30 dneh od dne po prihodu. Če vizum za prebivanje dobite šele na Tajvanu, BOCA šteje 30 dni od njegove izdaje. Neposredna prijava obiskovalca pri NIA zahteva izpolnitev pogojev njegove kategorije; veljaven združen dokument s funkcijo ARC pa omogoča izjemo od ločene prijave.
Koliko znaša običajna pristojbina za ARC?

Za vsako leto odobrene veljavnosti znaša NT$1.000; obdobje, krajše od leta, se obračuna kot leto. Za zadevne prijave po brezvizumskem vstopu ali vstopu z vizumom za obisk se prišteje NT$2.200. Posebne oprostitve in znižanja veljajo le za določene upravičence.

Thirty days is the filing period for your first Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) if you enter Taiwan on a resident visa and receive residence permission. Count from the day after arrival. [Immigration Act Article 22](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=22) requires the application to the National Immigration Agency (NIA), which issues the card as evidence of approved residence.

Visitors have a different starting point: they must qualify for a permitted change to residence before they can apply. Holding a valid combined document with ARC functions, such as an Employment Gold Card, removes the need for a separate card under the exception in [Article 22](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=22).

## Which date starts the application period?

Your visa and entry record determine the deadline. Someone who receives a resident visa while already in Taiwan uses a different starting date from someone who arrives with one.

| Entry and visa status | When to apply |
|---|---|
| Entered with a resident visa | Within 30 days counted from the day after entry. |
| Received a resident visa after arriving in Taiwan | Within 30 days from the resident visa's issuance date, under BOCA's guidance. |
| Entered visa-exempt or with a visitor visa | Before the permitted stay expires, subject to the eligibility and filing rules for the residence category. |

[NIA's residence guide](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970) and [BOCA's resident-visa guidance](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-166-276-48430-2.html) explain the first two situations. For eligible professionals, [Article 16 of the Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) permits a direct NIA residence application after visitor-visa or visa-exempt entry, with work authorization or an applicable exemption. Eligibility is specific to that route; the [work, study and family comparison](/en/columns/taiwan-visa-residence-work-study-family) explains the conditions for other applicants.

## Documents that establish your residence basis

An application based on a resident visa needs the form, photograph, passport and resident visa, evidence of the reason for residence, and proof of your current address, according to [NIA's checklist](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970). Bring the required originals and copies. A lease is one accepted address document.

The supporting evidence depends on why you are staying:

- Employment: the relevant work approval and a certificate of employment issued within the preceding month, or evidence of the applicable exemption.
- Degree study: an admission letter before registration, or recent enrollment evidence once registered.
- Family residence: marriage or birth records proving the relationship, together with the sponsoring family member's identity or residence documents.

For a first application through marriage to a Taiwan national with household registration, the Taiwan spouse must attend. NIA also requires proof that the marriage is registered in Taiwan and gives the first spouse-based card one-year validity. These requirements appear in the [NIA guide](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970); the [Taiwan-spouse residence article](/en/columns/taiwan-foreign-spouse-residence) covers the family documents in more detail.

Certificates issued abroad may take longer to prepare than the application form. NIA requires authentication of overseas documents and may ask for a Chinese translation verified or notarized in the prescribed manner. The [Taiwan overseas mission responsible for the place of issue](https://www.boca.gov.tw/sp-foof-countrylp-01-2.html) can explain the authentication procedure. Police certificates and health examinations depend on the particular visa or residence category; they are not required in every first-card application.

## Where the application goes

NIA's [residence application directory](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5382/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/) separates general residence applications from those for professionals and their dependents, students, and migrant workers. Each category has a designated online system or service-center procedure. Using the professional-worker system is appropriate only if your employment category belongs there.

Students use a [dedicated online procedure](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/417829/cp_news). For the ordinary in-person application, the relevant NIA service center is the one covering your current address; NIA specifically directs Taiwan-spouse applications there in its [residence guide](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970).

Keep the submission record and uploaded documents. If NIA requests further evidence, retaining the request with the original file makes it clear which documents still need to be supplied.

## Fees, processing and collection

Standard ARC fees are NT$1,000 for each year of approved validity, with a period under one year charged as a full year. [Article 3 of the immigration permit fee standards](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080135) adds NT$2,200 for applications following visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. Its reduction for overseas compatriot students applies to that status, not to international students generally.

NIA decides the approved term. The ordinary statutory maximum is three years, while qualifying specialist professionals have a separate maximum under their legislation ([Immigration Act Article 22](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=22); [Foreign Professionals Act Article 8](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295)). Paying a higher fee cannot establish eligibility for a longer period.

For general applications, [NIA gives a processing time of ten working days](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970), excluding document return, requests for additional documents and interviews. The processing period starts again after the additional documents are submitted. Online categories have their own schedules, which may affect travel plans while the application is pending.

Under the [student online procedure](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/417829/cp_news), payment is due within five working days from approval. A student collecting a smart-chip ARC must print the online payment receipt and take it to the selected NIA service center three working days after payment. That timetable applies to this student procedure; other applicants should follow the method and identification requirements in their approval or collection notice.

Check the issued card against your application. The name, passport details, address and residence expiry date should match the approved particulars; keep the receipt and decision with your immigration records.

An ARC alone does not authorize every job. Before starting work, the relevant permit or exemption must cover the actual employment under [Employment Service Act Articles 43 and 48](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001). Once you have the card, its expiry date and any later changes to your address or employment determine the next filings; travel may also require attention to re-entry permission. Those situations are covered in the [renewal and changes guide](/en/columns/taiwan-arc-renewal-changes-reentry).

Sources checked October 24, 2026. This procedural guide concerns foreign nationals and does not determine individual eligibility. Mainland China residents, Hong Kong and Macau residents, and ROC nationals without household registration follow separate frameworks.

## Official sources

- [Immigration Act, Article 22](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=22): first-card deadline, integrated-document exception and ordinary validity limit.
- [NIA, residence, extension and change applications](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970), updated April 14, 2026: documents, fees, processing and spouse attendance.
- [BOCA, resident visas for professional employees](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-166-276-48430-2.html): ARC timing following resident visa issuance in Taiwan.
- [Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295), Articles 8 and 16: specialist validity and direct residence applications.
- [NIA, residence application directory](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5382/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/): category-specific application channels.
- [NIA, student online applications](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/417829/cp_news), updated August 28, 2026: student filing, payment and collection.
- [Taiwan overseas mission directory](https://www.boca.gov.tw/sp-foof-countrylp-01-2.html): document authentication inquiries.
- [Immigration permit fee standards](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080135), Article 3: ARC fees and specified reductions.
- [Employment Service Act](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001), Articles 43 and 48: work authorization and exemptions.

Za dopolnitev običajne vloge [kitajska navodila NIA 0902](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/29996/) določajo 15 dni od dne po obvestilu. Gre za koledarske dni. Če je treba manjkajoče ali neustrezne listine pridobiti v tujini, celinski Kitajski, Hongkongu ali Macau, je rok za dopolnitev tri mesece; ne prišteva se k prvotnim 15 dnem. NIA prijavo zavrne, če zahtevane dopolnitve niso predložene pravočasno ali ostanejo nepopolne.

## Pristojbina, odločitev in prevzem izkaznice

Običajna pristojbina je NT$1.000 za vsako leto odobrene veljavnosti, krajše obdobje pa se obračuna kot eno leto. [3. člen pravil o pristojbinah](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080135) za zadevne prijave po brezvizumskem vstopu ali vizumu za obisk dodaja NT$2.200. Polovično znižanje za kategorijo študentov iz čezmorske kitajske skupnosti, 僑生, ne velja za vse mednarodne študente.

Trajanje določi dovoljena podlaga prebivanja. Običajna zakonska zgornja meja je tri leta, za zaposlene strokovnjake s posebnimi znanji in določene družinske člane pa velja posebna ureditev do petih let ([22. člen zakona o priseljevanju](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=22); [8. člen zakona o tujih strokovnjakih](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295)). Gold Card ima svojo veljavnost od enega do treh let. Višje plačilo samo ne zagotovi daljšega prebivanja.

[NIA za običajno vlogo navaja deset delovnih dni](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970), brez časa za vračanje listin, dopolnitve in razgovore. Po dopolnitvi se čas obravnave šteje znova. Pri študentskem spletnem postopku je navedeni čas pet delovnih dni in se po dopolnitvi prav tako začne znova. To ni zagotovljen datum izdaje ali samodejno podaljšanje dovoljenega bivanja.

Kdaj študent plača in dobi kartico? Po [študentskih spletnih navodilih](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/417829/cp_news) mora plačati v petih delovnih dneh od odobritve. Elektronski ARC z veljavnostjo največ šest mesecev mora po plačilu prenesti in natisniti. Za kartico s čipom mora natisniti spletno potrdilo o plačilu in jo prevzeti v izbranem centru NIA tri delovne dni po plačilu. Drugi prosilci upoštevajo način prevzema, naveden v svoji odločbi oziroma obvestilu.

Ob prevzemu primerjajte ime, potni list, naslov in datum izteka z odobrenimi podatki. Odločbo in potrdilo shranite skupaj. Za začetek dela mora ustrezno dovoljenje ali izjema pokrivati konkretno zaposlitev po [43. in 48. členu zakona o zaposlitvenih storitvah](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001); ARC sam ne dovoljuje vsakega dela. Poznejše spremembe naslova, zaposlitve ali potovalnih načrtov obravnava [vodnik po podaljšanju in ponovnem vstopu](/sl/columns/taiwan-arc-renewal-changes-reentry).

Podlaga so uradni viri, preverjeni 24. in 25. oktobra 2026. Besedilo obravnava sistem za tuje državljane. Prebivalci celinske Kitajske, Hongkonga in Macaa ter tajvanski državljani brez gospodinjske registracije imajo ločene pravne okvire.

## Uradni viri

- [Zakon o priseljevanju, 22. člen](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=22): rok, združeni dokumenti in običajna najdaljša veljavnost.
- [NIA 0902, prijava prebivanja in sprememb](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970), posodobljeno 14. aprila 2026: listine, navzočnost zakonca in obravnava; [kitajska različica](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/29996/): rok za dopolnitev.
- [BOCA, vizum za prebivanje strokovnih delavcev](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-166-276-48430-2.html): ARC po izdaji vizuma na Tajvanu.
- [Zakon o pridobivanju in zaposlovanju tujih strokovnjakov](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295), 8., 9. in 16. člen: posebna veljavnost in neposredna prijava.
- [NIA, imenik postopkov za prebivanje](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5382/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/): izbira prijavne poti.
- [NIA 0929, študentske spletne prijave](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/417829/cp_news), posodobljeno 28. avgusta 2026: obravnava, plačilo in prevzem.
- [Imenik tajvanskih predstavništev](https://www.boca.gov.tw/sp-foof-countrylp-01-2.html): overitve listin.
- [Pravila o pristojbinah za dovoljenja](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080135), 3. člen: zneski in znižanja.
- [Zakon o zaposlitvenih storitvah](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001), 43. in 48. člen: delovna dovoljenja in izjeme.

sourceEvidence.text: For entry with a resident visa and residence permission, the 30-day period starts the day after arrival. If the resident visa is issued after you arrive, BOCA's guidance counts 30 days from its issuance. Visitors applying directly for residence must meet the eligibility and filing rules for their category.

The standard charge is NT$1,000 for each year of approved validity; a period under one year is charged as one year. Applications after visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry carry an additional NT$2,200 under the fee rules. Specified reductions and exemptions may apply.

Thirty days is the filing period for your first Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) if you enter Taiwan on a resident visa and receive residence permission. Count from the day after arrival. Immigration Act Article 22 requires the application to the National Immigration Agency (NIA), which issues the card as evidence of approved residence.

Visitors have a different starting point: they must qualify for a permitted change to residence before they can apply. Holding a valid combined document with ARC functions, such as an Employment Gold Card, removes the need for a separate card under the exception in Article 22.
Within 30 days counted from the day after entry.
Within 30 days from the resident visa's issuance date, under BOCA's guidance.

NIA's residence guide and BOCA's resident-visa guidance explain the first two situations. For eligible professionals, Article 16 of the Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals permits a direct NIA residence application after visitor-visa or visa-exempt entry, with work authorization or an applicable exemption. Eligibility is specific to that route; the work, study and family comparison explains the conditions for other applicants.

Standard ARC fees are NT$1,000 for each year of approved validity, with a period under one year charged as a full year. Article 3 of the immigration permit fee standards adds NT$2,200 for applications following visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. Its reduction for overseas compatriot students applies to that status, not to international students generally.

NIA decides the approved term. The ordinary statutory maximum is three years, while qualifying specialist professionals have a separate maximum under their legislation (Immigration Act Article 22; Foreign Professionals Act Article 8). Paying a higher fee cannot establish eligibility for a longer period.

An ARC alone does not authorize every job. Before starting work, the relevant permit or exemption must cover the actual employment under Employment Service Act Articles 43 and 48. Once you have the card, its expiry date and any later changes to your address or employment determine the next filings; travel may also require attention to re-entry permission. Those situations are covered in the renewal and changes guide.

sourceHints.text: Thirty days is the filing period for your first Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) if you enter Taiwan on a resident visa and receive residence permission. Count from the day after arrival. Immigration Act Article 22 requires the application to the National Immigration Agency (NIA), which issues the card as evidence of approved residence.
Your visa and entry record determine the deadline. Someone who receives a resident visa while already in Taiwan uses a different starting date from someone who arrives with one.
Received a resident visa after arriving in Taiwan

An application based on a resident visa needs the form, photograph, passport and resident visa, evidence of the reason for residence, and proof of your current address, according to NIA's checklist. Bring the required originals and copies. A lease is one accepted address document.

For a first application through marriage to a Taiwan national with household registration, the Taiwan spouse must attend. NIA also requires proof that the marriage is registered in Taiwan and gives the first spouse-based card one-year validity. These requirements appear in the NIA guide; the Taiwan-spouse residence article covers the family documents in more detail.

Certificates issued abroad may take longer to prepare than the application form. NIA requires authentication of overseas documents and may ask for a Chinese translation verified or notarized in the prescribed manner. The Taiwan overseas mission responsible for the place of issue can explain the authentication procedure. Police certificates and health examinations depend on the particular visa or residence category; they are not required in every first-card application.

Students use a dedicated online procedure. For the ordinary in-person application, the relevant NIA service center is the one covering your current address; NIA specifically directs Taiwan-spouse applications there in its residence guide.

Check the issued card against your application. The name, passport details, address and residence expiry date should match the approved particulars; keep the receipt and decision with your immigration records.

Sources checked October 24, 2026. This procedural guide concerns foreign nationals and does not determine individual eligibility. Mainland China residents, Hong Kong and Macau residents, and ROC nationals without household registration follow separate frameworks.

targetFields.text: Delo, študij ali družina: s katerim statusom na Tajvan?
Prebivanje na Tajvanu zaradi dela, študija in družine
Brezvizumski prihod omogoča nekatere prijave strokovnjakov, pri študiju pa lahko zapre običajno pot do prebivanja. Pogoji so odvisni tudi od družinskega člana in namena vizuma.
Zaprt prenosnik, knjige in dve skodelici ob nevtralni potni knjižici.
Izmišljen prizor
Ali lahko po brezvizumskem prihodu zaprosim za prebivanje?

Za upravičene tuje strokovnjake z delovnim dovoljenjem ali ustrezno izjemo 16. člen posebnega zakona omogoča neposredno prijavo pri NIA. Posebej določa pot za nekatere družinske člane. Preveriti je treba tudi uporabljeno ureditev vstopa. Običajni poti za študij in učenje kitajščine imata drugačne vstopne pogoje.
Koliko časa moram obiskovati tečaj kitajščine pred prijavo za prebivanje?

Pot zahteva ustrezen vizum za obisk zaradi učenja jezika, štiri zaključene mesece pri upravičenem univerzitetnem jezikovnem centru in vpis še za najmanj tri mesece. Izpolniti je treba tudi pogoje glede ur, navzočnosti in dokazil. Samo plačilo tečaja ne zadostuje.
Ali vsak imetnik ARC lahko omogoči prebivanje zakoncu?

Ne. Odločilni so državljanstvo in status družinskega člana na Tajvanu, sorodstveno razmerje ter način vstopa prosilca. Pravila za družino tujega strokovnjaka in za zakonca tajvanskega državljana so različna; zakon nekatere kategorije izključuje.

source.seoTitle: Taiwan Residence for Work, Study and Family
source.summary: Taiwan residence rules for work, study and family depend on the proposed activity, sponsor and entry visa. Eligibility needs to be settled before travel.

faq.q: Can I apply for residence after entering Taiwan visa-exempt?
faq.a: Article 16 of the Foreign Professionals Act allows qualifying professionals with work authorization or an exemption, and certain family members, to apply directly to NIA. Eligibility also depends on the entry arrangement used. Ordinary degree-study and Mandarin-study routes have different entry requirements.

faq.q: How long must I study Mandarin before applying for an ARC?
faq.a: The residence route requires the appropriate study visitor visa, four completed months at a qualifying university-affiliated language center, and registration for at least three further months. Classroom hours, attendance and the required supporting documents also form part of the application conditions. Enrollment alone is insufficient.

faq.q: Can every ARC holder sponsor a spouse for residence?
faq.a: No. The sponsor's nationality and residence category, the relationship and the applicant's entry status all affect eligibility. The rules for a foreign professional's family differ from those for a spouse of a Taiwan national, and statutory exclusions apply to some sponsors.

sourcePassages.text: Visa-exempt entry may suit a qualifying professional who intends to apply for residence in Taiwan, but it can rule out the ordinary in-country application for a degree or Mandarin student. Foreign Professionals Act Article 16 permits the professional route; BOCA's degree-study and Mandarin-study guidance set different entry conditions for students.
Nationality and the passport used determine visa eligibility. The Taiwan overseas mission handling your application provides the nationality-specific requirements and document procedures.

A temporary visitor's permitted activities and length of stay depend on the entry arrangement granted. A longer move requires a residence basis, such as employment, study or joining family. BOCA's resident-visa guidance covers those purposes, while the National Immigration Agency (NIA) decides residence applications and issues the Alien Resident Certificate (ARC).
Some eligible visitors can apply directly to NIA. Other applicants need the appropriate visa before entry, so arriving as a visitor leaves no general right to convert a short stay into residence.

For most foreign professional hires, the employer applies for a work permit, subject to statutory exceptions and the authority responsible for the job. Articles 4 and 5 of the Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals define professional work and the permit framework. A signed offer is not work authorization.

Once a qualifying foreign professional or foreign specialist professional has the permit or an applicable exemption, Article 16 allows a direct residence application following visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. NIA must still approve the residence application before issuing an ARC. The current Article 16 took effect on January 1, 2026, as recorded in the Act's legislative history.

NIA's guide excludes trial visa exemptions, the Southeast Asian online travel-authorization scheme and other listed entry arrangements from this direct-application route unless another rule applies, even where the applicant holds work approval.

Care work, fishing and other migrant-worker categories under Employment Service Act Article 46 have their own rules. NIA's migrant-worker residence procedure applies to those categories; employment in Taiwan does not by itself place a worker within the foreign-professional scheme. The category on the work approval identifies which procedure to use.

Full-time foreign students applying from abroad can seek a resident visa at a Taiwan overseas mission. Those who enter on a visitor visa specifically for foreign-student study may apply directly to NIA for residence. The ordinary in-country study route in BOCA's student guidance excludes visa-exempt entry, landing visas and visitor visas issued for other purposes.

Depending on the application, BOCA also requires educational records, financial evidence and a health certificate alongside the admission letter; the program's checklist determines which overseas records need authentication.

For Mandarin learners, the language-study visitor visa ordinarily comes before arrival. Eligibility for residence follows four completed months at a qualifying university-affiliated center, with registration for at least three more months. BOCA's Mandarin residence guidance requires at least 15 classroom hours a week, Monday through Friday. Absences, including leave, may not exceed one quarter of class hours. Tuition payment alone does not establish eligibility.

Can a student take a part-time job? Employment Service Act Articles 43 and 50 govern work permits and specified student employment. The admission letter and student ARC do not replace the work authorization needed for the job.

Family residence depends on the sponsor's status and the relationship. For a spouse of a Taiwan national residing in Taiwan with household registration, one in-country route under Immigration Act Article 23 requires a valid visa allowing a stay of at least 60 days and without the specified restrictions. Marriage therefore does not establish a general right to convert visa-exempt entry to residence. The required relationship documents and related status issues appear in residence through a Taiwan spouse.

When a foreign professional engaged in professional work in Taiwan or a foreign specialist professional already has approved residence or permanent residence, Article 16 allows certain family members to apply directly after visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. It covers a spouse, minor children, and adult children unable to care for themselves because of physical or mental disability. Parents and other adult children are excluded.

Work rights vary by family category. Employment Service Act Article 48 provides a work-permit exemption for an approved resident married to a Taiwan national with household registration. Dependent spouses of foreign professionals cannot assume that exemption applies to them. targetPassages.text: Sprejem na univerzo še ne pove, s katerim vizumom naj študent pride na Tajvan. Pri običajni študijski poti lahko brezvizumski prihod onemogoči prijavo za prebivanje v državi, medtem ko 16. člen zakona o tujih strokovnjakih nekaterim strokovnjakom takšno neposredno prijavo omogoča. Zato je treba namen selitve povezati z vstopnim statusom pred potovanjem.

BOCA za redni študij in učenje kitajščine objavlja ločene pogoje. Državljanstvo in uporabljeni potni list vplivata na vizumsko upravičenost. Podrobnosti za konkretno prijavo poda pristojno tajvansko predstavništvo.

Kratkotrajno bivanje ima dovoljen namen in končni datum, ki izhajata iz odobrenega načina vstopa. Za daljšo selitev je potrebna podlaga za prebivanje, denimo delo, študij ali družinska vez. Navodila BOCA za vizume za prebivanje obravnavajo te namene, o prebivanju in izkaznici ARC pa odloča Nacionalna agencija za priseljevanje, NIA.

Nekateri obiskovalci lahko zaprosijo neposredno pri NIA. Drugi potrebujejo ustrezen vizum že pred prihodom. Zgolj dejstvo, da ste zakonito vstopili in našli stanovanje, zato ne potrdi možnosti spremembe statusa.

Delodajalec pri večini zaposlitev tujih strokovnjakov zaprosi za delovno dovoljenje. 4. in 5. člen zakona o pridobivanju in zaposlovanju tujih strokovnjakov določata strokovno delo, sistem dovoljenj in izjeme; pristojni organ je odvisen tudi od vrste dela. Podpisana ponudba sama ne dovoljuje začetka dela.

Ko ima tuji strokovnjak ali strokovnjak s posebnimi znanji dovoljenje za strokovno delo oziroma ustrezno zakonsko izjemo, mu 16. člen po brezvizumskem vstopu ali vstopu z vizumom za obisk omogoča neposredno prošnjo za prebivanje. NIA mora prošnjo odobriti, preden izda ARC. Sedanja ureditev tega člena velja od 1. januarja 2026, kot izhaja iz uradne zgodovine zakona.

Preveriti je treba natančno ureditev vstopa. Navodila NIA iz te neposredne poti izključujejo poskusne brezvizumske ureditve, spletno potovalno dovoljenje za določene države jugovzhodne Azije in druge navedene možnosti, razen kadar se uporablja druga določba. Delovno dovoljenje samo ne odpravi teh omejitev.

Negovalno delo, ribištvo in druge kategorije delavcev po 46. členu zakona o zaposlitvenih storitvah imajo svoja pravila. Zanje NIA objavlja poseben postopek za prebivanje delavcev. Kategorijo poiščite na odobritvi dela; vsaka zaposlitev na Tajvanu ne spada v sistem tujih strokovnjakov.

Tuji študenti rednega študija lahko iz tujine zaprosijo za vizum za prebivanje pri tajvanskem predstavništvu. Kdor vstopi z vizumom za obisk, izdanim prav zaradi študija tujega študenta, lahko po ustrezni poti zaprosi neposredno pri NIA. Običajna prijava za študijsko prebivanje na Tajvanu po navodilih BOCA ni na voljo po brezvizumskem vstopu, vizumu ob prihodu ali vizumu za obisk z drugim namenom.

Poleg sprejemnega pisma lahko konkretna prijava zahteva dokazila o izobrazbi, finančnih sredstvih in zdravstvenem pregledu. Seznam izbrane poti določa tudi overitve tujih listin. Shranite potrdilo, za kateri program in način študija ste bili sprejeti.

Pri učenju kitajščine se vizum za obisk zaradi jezikovnega študija praviloma pridobi pred prihodom. Za prebivanje je treba pri upravičenem jezikovnem centru, povezanem z univerzo, zaključiti štiri mesece učenja in se vpisati še za najmanj tri mesece. Po navodilih BOCA za jezikovno prebivanje mora pouk od ponedeljka do petka obsegati vsaj 15 ur na teden, odsotnosti skupaj z dovoljenimi izostanki pa ne smejo preseči četrtine učnih ur. Plačana šolnina teh pogojev ne nadomesti.

Ali študentski ARC omogoča popoldansko delo? 43. in 50. člen zakona o zaposlitvenih storitvah urejata potrebno dovoljenje in študentsko zaposlitev. Za študente, ki sodijo v to ureditev, je delo omejeno na 20 ur na teden, razen med poletnimi in zimskimi počitnicami. Izkaznica o prebivanju in sprejemno pismo sama ne nadomestita dovoljenja.

Pri zakoncu tajvanskega državljana sta pomembni njegovo prebivanje na Tajvanu in gospodinjska registracija. Ena od poti znotraj države po 23. členu zakona o priseljevanju zahteva veljaven vizum, ki dovoljuje vsaj 60 dni bivanja, brez prepovedi podaljšanja in drugih navedenih omejitev. Poroka torej ne daje splošne pravice do spremembe brezvizumskega obiska v prebivanje. Dokumentacija za zakonca tajvanskega državljana je podrobneje opisana v angleščini.

Za družino tujega strokovnjaka 16. člen posebnega zakona loči dve možnosti. Družinski član na Tajvanu je lahko običajni tuji strokovnjak, ki tam opravlja strokovno delo, ali tuji strokovnjak s posebnimi znanji. V obeh primerih mora imeti pri NIA odobreno prebivanje ali stalno prebivanje.

Neposredno lahko po brezvizumskem vstopu ali vizumu za obisk zaprosijo njegov zakonec, mladoletni otroci in odrasli otroci, ki zaradi telesne ali duševne oviranosti ne morejo skrbeti zase. ARC dobijo po odobritvi. Staršev in drugih odraslih otrok ta določba ne vključuje. Pri drugih družinskih poteh je treba preveriti še zakonske izključitve glede statusa osebe, na katero se prijava opira.

Pravica do dela sledi lastnim pravilom. 48. člen zakona o zaposlitvenih storitvah dovoljuje izjemo od delovnega dovoljenja tujcu z odobrenim prebivanjem, ki je poročen s tajvanskim državljanom z gospodinjsko registracijo. Zakonec tujega strokovnjaka te izjeme ne pridobi samodejno. Upravičenemu zakoncu strokovnjaka s posebnimi znanji ali strokovnjaka na najvišji ravni 15. člen posebnega zakona omogoča lastno prošnjo za delovno dovoljenje. Njegova veljavnost ne sme preseči dovoljenega družinskega prebivanja.

Employment Gold Card združuje delovno dovoljenje, vizum za prebivanje, ARC in dovoljenje za ponovni vstop. Namenjena je strokovnjakom s posebnimi znanji, ki izpolnijo merila programa, in velja od enega do treh let. O prošnji ni odločeno že s tem, da ima kandidat dobro ponudbo za delo. Ločena razlaga prijave za Gold Card je v angleščini.

Za ustanavljanje podjetja BOCA objavlja pogoje podjetniške poti. Poslovni načrt je zato treba povezati s kategorijo prebivanja in njenimi dokazili, preden se zanesete na predvideni datum začetka poslovanja.

Delovne počitnice so vezane na program za konkretno državljanstvo. Vizum za obisk digitalnih nomadov ima druge pogoje glede državljanstva in upravičenosti ter ne vodi samodejno do ARC. 14. člen zakona o tujih strokovnjakih to pot dela na daljavo omejuje na upravičeno delo brez opravljanja storitev za tajvanska podjetja ali delodajalce.

Ko je podlaga izbrana, vodnik za prvi ARC poveže rok, listine in prevzem. Če ARC že imate in menjate službo, študij ali družinsko podlago, preverite pravila o spremembi razloga in podaljšanju. V spisu naj bosta razvidna odobreni sedanji namen in dejanski namen po spremembi.

Besedilo uporablja uradne vire, preverjene 24. in 25. oktobra 2026. Obravnava tuje državljane; prebivalci celinske Kitajske, Hongkonga in Macaa ter tajvanski državljani brez gospodinjske registracije imajo ločene pravne okvire. Upravičenost je treba ugotoviti za konkretnega prosilca.
Zakon o pridobivanju in zaposlovanju tujih strokovnjakov, 4., 5., 9., 14., 15. in 16. člen; uradna zgodovina.
Zakon o priseljevanju, 23. člen: upravičene prijave za prebivanje v državi.
Zakon o zaposlitvenih storitvah, 43., 46., 48. in 50. člen: kategorije dela, dovoljenja in študenti.
BOCA: vizumi za prebivanje, redni tuji študenti, vizumi za obisk zaradi kitajščine, prebivanje zaradi kitajščine.
NIA, prijava po vizumu za obisk ali brezvizumskem vstopu, opomba 7(1), posodobljeno 14. aprila 2026: izključene ureditve vstopa in druge zakonske podlage.
NIA, prebivanje delavcev v posebnih zaposlitvenih kategorijah.
Uradne informacije o Gold Card in podjetniška gradiva BOCA.
BOCA: delovne počitnice in vizum digitalnih nomadov.
Imenik tajvanskih predstavništev: pristojni konzularni urad.
Dovoljen obisk in podlaga za prebivanje
Začetek dela zahteva dovoljenje ali zakonsko izjemo
Redni študij in tečaj kitajščine imata različne pogoje
Na kateri družinski status se opira prijava?
Gold Card, ustanovitev podjetja in daljši obisk
Uradni viri
Ali lahko po brezvizumskem prihodu zaprosim za prebivanje?

Za upravičene tuje strokovnjake z delovnim dovoljenjem ali ustrezno izjemo 16. člen posebnega zakona omogoča neposredno prijavo pri NIA. Posebej določa pot za nekatere družinske člane. Preveriti je treba tudi uporabljeno ureditev vstopa. Običajni poti za študij in učenje kitajščine imata drugačne vstopne pogoje.
Koliko časa moram obiskovati tečaj kitajščine pred prijavo za prebivanje?

Pot zahteva ustrezen vizum za obisk zaradi učenja jezika, štiri zaključene mesece pri upravičenem univerzitetnem jezikovnem centru in vpis še za najmanj tri mesece. Izpolniti je treba tudi pogoje glede ur, navzočnosti in dokazil. Samo plačilo tečaja ne zadostuje.
Ali vsak imetnik ARC lahko omogoči prebivanje zakoncu?

Ne. Odločilni so državljanstvo in status družinskega člana na Tajvanu, sorodstveno razmerje ter način vstopa prosilca. Pravila za družino tujega strokovnjaka in za zakonca tajvanskega državljana so različna; zakon nekatere kategorije izključuje.
